predictions.articleTitle: Decoupling Charleroi vs SK Beveren: Expected Goals (xG), Squad Absences & Match Analysis
predictions.coreRecommendation: Charleroi are projected to secure a regulation-time Home Win built on superior xG creation and SK Beveren's confirmed midfield absences.
possibilityAssessment: Primary Home Win projection backed by Charleroi's 2.51 home goal expectancy and Beveren's six-match winless away run (Confidence: High, Value: Moderate)
Over 2.5 goals paired with BTTS No driven by Charleroi's home scoring volume against a depleted Beveren midfield missing Verschueren and Condé (Confidence: Moderate, Value: High)
Controlled 2:0 home victory branch if Charleroi's high big-chance waste rate slows early conversion before second-half game management (Confidence: Moderate, Value: Moderate)

bet_recommendations.match_highlight: Charleroi's high-tempo attack hosts depleted SK Beveren missing two midfielders.

spf.comment: Charleroi's 1.89 xG attack and intact starting core should overpower a winless-away SK Beveren missing suspended Arno Verschueren and injured Cheick Condé.

over_under.comment: A 3.37 combined lambda and five of six home and away league games clearing 2.5 goals support three goals primarily from Charleroi's attack.

btts.comment: SK Beveren have failed to score in four of six away trips and lose key creators Arno Verschueren and Ilyes Najim against a side with Mohamed Koné cleared in goal.

score.comment: 3:0 reflects Charleroi's 2.51 home lambda against Beveren's 1.93 xGA road defense, while 2:0 covers a slower tempo-controlled margin.

goals.comment: Three and two goals represent the top two exact totals in the Poisson distribution at 21.9% and 19.9%, aligning directly with 3:0 and 2:0.

bqc.comment: Charleroi convert all half-time leads into wins while Beveren trail at the break in two-thirds of away matches, with Draw-Win covering a tight opening 45 minutes.
